chapter_title: Chapter 1: Fifth High School of the Immortal Sect

scenes.description: Chen Mobai updates his cultivation realm to Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement on his smartphone, prompting an envious reaction from his deskmate who finds the disparity in their 'True' and 'Pseudo' Spiritual Roots unfair.
scenes.image_prompt: A handsome young man, Chen Mobai, with a slight smirk, seated by a sunlit classroom window, tapping on a glowing, jade-like smartphone displaying 'Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement'. His deskmate, with a visibly flushed and indignant face, leans over his shoulder, eyes wide with envy, in a brightly lit, modern-futuristic school classroom.

scenes.description: The homeroom teacher, Chai Deyun, commends students for their holiday progress, including Chen Mobai, but reserves special praise for the elite students Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan, who have reached Seventh-Stage Qi Refinement, highlighting the protagonist's envy.
scenes.image_prompt: A stern-faced male teacher, Chai Deyun, with a rare, soft smile, stands at a podium in a modern-futuristic classroom, gesturing towards two distinguished students, Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan, who stand proudly beside their desks. Other students, including Chen Mobai with a mix of smugness and envy, watch from their desks as sunlight streams through large windows.

scenes.description: Upon class dismissal, students frantically rush to secure empty cultivation chambers, with Chen Mobai using his improved Lightness Technique to quickly secure a room, much to another classmate's dismay.
scenes.image_prompt: A chaotic scene of students in sleek, futuristic school uniforms rushing out of a classroom through windows and doorways as a bell rings from a distant, towering spire. Chen Mobai, agile and mid-leap from a window, clutches his smartphone, a determined expression on his face, racing ahead of other scrambling students towards a glowing hall in the distance.

scenes.description: Inside his secured cultivation chamber, Chen Mobai reflects on the severe scarcity and high cost of concentrated spiritual energy on Diyuan Star, as the narrative details the different tiers and prices cultivators must pay in Merit Points.
scenes.image_prompt: Chen Mobai, looking focused and determined, stands in a small, sterile, approximately three-square-meter cultivation chamber with plain walls, holding his jade-like smartphone displaying 'Spiritual Energy Value: 10'. A "Vacant" sign on a digital display near the slowly closing door has just vanished, and a sense of subtle, rising energy fills the enclosed space.
